articles.title: Massive tenant fraud crisis exposed in new study
articles.summary: LegalforLandlords surveyed 1,000 UK landlords - 77% believe tenant fraud has worsened.
articles.ai_summary:

- Conducted by LegalforLandlords, the study surveyed 1,000 landlords, emphasizing widespread concerns over fraudulent tenant activity.

articles.title: NRLA ramps up campaign against rent controls
articles.summary: Concern is growing that the new PM wants private sector rent controls
articles.ai_summary:

articles.title: Tenants know rent controls push out landlords – but still want them
articles.summary: It's a survey of 5,607 tenants by flat-sharing website SpareRoom
articles.ai_summary:
- A recent survey of 5,607 tenants by SpareRoom reveals that while tenants understand rent controls may deter landlords, they still favor their implementation.
  
- The findings highlight a significant tenant desire for affordability in the rental market, despite potential consequences for landlord participation.
